Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

SPECIFICATION FOR 
BOX SPANNERS FOR RAIL SCREWS 



1. Scope— Lays down the requirements for box spanners for rail screws used by the Indian 
Railways.

3. Material ~ Suitable steels meeting v/lth the requirements iaid^down in 4 and 7.

4. Hardness — 380 to 430 W ( ;::J 39 to 43 HRC ). 

5. Tommy Bars — Tommy bars shall conform to Type A and nominal size 20 mm of IS : 6002-1971 
* Tommy bars for box spanners '• 

6. Designation — A box spanner of nominal size 1, shall be designated as: 

Box Spanner 1 IS : 7663 

7. Tests — Box spanners for rail screws shall be tested for torque test according to 10.1 of 
IS: 2030-1971 'Specification for box spanners (first revision)*. The testing torque shall be 
884 N.m. 

8. Marking — A box spanner for rail screws shall be marked with the nominal size and the manu- 
facturer's initials or the recognized trade-mark. 

8.1 ISI Certificatior) MarA/nflf — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution.
